title: A reply that lands after the person left its thread saves nothing, but reopening that thread shows the reply as if it had saved
evidence: Design 2026-11-13 (docs/drafts/c22-c26-design.md, PR 1643): not built. The reply is stored by sendMessage before done knows the person left, so the reopened thread already shows what is stored; the ruled marker needs new words, a stored message field (chat-history.ts, chat-session.ts: engine) and iPhone parity. Options (A) as ruled, (B) the marker only on a reply with edits, (C) hold for the iPhone chat series. Earlier: Fable ruled 2026-11-12 on PR 1306: a reply arriving after an A to B thread switch applies nothing, valid edits included. Condition: thread A must not later read as if it saved. The "Not saved" words today are a banner only (widget-src/src/components/ChatEdits.tsx RECORD_CHANGED_SINCE_ASKED), not stored on the turn (lib/chat-api.ts ChatMessage has no such field), so reopening A shows the reply's words with no marker. Wanted: store the marker on that turn so reopening A shows "Not saved: you opened another conversation before this reply arrived." Same for the iPhone (parity). Fits the chat-turn reducer (chat-turn.ts).
